settings.title: Fit & Care
settings.content:
This is a pre-order. You order now, the run goes into production, and your size is cut with it and shipped to you first. Charged at checkout, which is what reserves the size. If the run is delayed beyond the date shown we write to you and you can cancel for a full refund.

Cut easy and straight from hip to hem, with room through the leg. This is not the chino block — there is no taper below the knee and no compression anywhere.

The drawcord waist sits without gripping, so take your true waist and let the cord do the rest.

Machine wash cold. Hang dry. Do not tumble dry. Linen softens with every wear.

settings.title: Details
settings.content:
A linen and cotton blend. Linen for the breathability, cotton for the shape — the blend holds a line where pure linen would drop, and it moves in heat rather than sticking to you.

Drawcord waist, clean straight leg, no cuff.

settings.content:

  • Australia: 2 to 4 days. Free standard shipping over $100, free express over $200.
  • New Zealand: 2 to 4 days. Free priority express over NZ$160.

Tracked door to door on every order.

settings.question: How do they fit?
settings.answer:
Easy and straight from hip to hem, with real room through the leg. This is not the chino block — no taper below the knee and no compression anywhere.

The drawcord waist sits without gripping, so take your true waist. If you are between sizes, size up.

settings.question: What is the fabric?
settings.answer:
A linen and cotton blend. Linen for the breathability, cotton for the shape — it holds a line where pure linen would drop, and it moves in heat rather than sticking to you.

It softens with every wear.

settings.question: Are they comfortable for all day wear?
settings.answer: It is built for heat rather than structure. The drawcord waist means nothing digs in when you sit, and the open leg moves air instead of holding it.

settings.question: What should I pair them with?
settings.answer: A Signature Shirt open at the collar and the Sanremo on your feet for a long lunch. A Weekend Tee and nothing else planned. It is the piece that makes the rest of a hot week easy.

settings.question: What is your return policy?
settings.answer:
44 days to decide, starting the day it arrives. Exchanges and returns are free within Australia and New Zealand, returned in the satchel it came in.

Outside Australia and New Zealand you cover the return postage. Duties and taxes are included in every price, so nothing is owed on arrival.

settings.question: When will they arrive?
settings.answer:
This is a pre-order. The run ships in early November 2026, and pre-orders go out first, the same afternoon they are picked. You are charged at checkout, which is what reserves your size.

If the run is delayed beyond that date we write to you, and you can cancel for a full refund.
